subject: pathology
title: Hashimoto Thyroiditis, Hurthle Cells, de Quervain and Riedel Thyroiditis, and Graves Disease

steps.tx: Hashimoto thyroiditis autoimmune destroys thyroid follicles through lymphocytic infiltration, germinal centres, and Hurthle metaplasia toward hypothyroidism in middle aged women with anti-TPO antibodies. That lymphocytic destruction is **Hashimoto (chronic lymphocytic) thyroiditis**. Anti-TPO antibodies appear in roughly nine of ten patients, a firm rubbery goitre is typical early, and a transient hashitoxicosis phase can mislead before hypothyroidism settles in.
steps.say: Lymphocytes, germinal centres, Hurthle cells, rising TSH: Hashimoto thyroiditis under the microscope.

steps.tx: Scan this thyroid section at low power before hunting for single cells. Pale thyroid follicles are being crowded out by dense lymphoid tissue that has organised itself into follicles with reactive germinal centres, exactly like a lymph node growing inside the gland. Scattered follicular cells swell with pink mitochondria rich cytoplasm as **Hurthle cells** within the Hashimoto gland.
steps.say: This thyroid section shows lymphoid follicles with germinal centres crowding out thyroid follicles, plus pink Hurthle cells. That organised lymphoid takeover is Hashimoto thyroiditis under the microscope.

steps.tx: Hurthle cells, oncocytic follicular cells stuffed with mitochondria turning abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, mark Hashimoto metaplasia yet also build Hurthle cell neoplasms requiring capsular invasion judgement. Those pink cells are **Hurthle (oncocytic) cells**. Cytology alone cannot separate Hurthle cell adenoma from carcinoma, because only capsular or vascular invasion on the excised specimen proves malignant behaviour.
steps.say: Hurthle cells are mitochondria rich pink follicular cells; in Hashimoto they reassure, in nodules they interrogate.

steps.tx: Subacute de Quervain thyroiditis tenderly inflames thyroid after viral illness with granulomas engulfing colloid, thyrotoxic leakage then hypothyroid recovery phases, low uptake separating leakage from Graves synthesis. That painful gland is **subacute (de Quervain) thyroiditis**. Pain often radiates to the jaw or ear, the erythrocyte sedimentation rate runs strikingly high, and nonsteroidal drugs suffice for mild cases while steroids settle severe ones.
steps.say: Painful tender thyroid with high hormones but low uptake is leakage, de Quervain thyroiditis, not Graves disease.

vis.caption: Radionuclide scan patterns separating Graves synthesis from destructive thyroiditis leakage in thyrotoxicosis.

steps.tx: Riedel thyroiditis fibroses thyroid into woody hardness invading strap muscles and parathyroids, IgG4 related sometimes, mimicking anaplastic cancer while strangling airways slowly. That woody fibrosis is **Riedel (invasive fibrous) thyroiditis**. Hypoparathyroidism can follow when fibrosis engulfs the parathyroids, and open biopsy is often required because needle samples cannot exclude anaplastic carcinoma confidently.
steps.say: A woody rock hard thyroid fixing to neighbours thinks Riedel fibrosis against anaplastic cancer.

steps.tx: Graves disease stimulates TSH receptors with antibodies causing diffuse hyperthyroidism, pretibial myxoedema, and orbitopathy from orbital fibroblast activation independent of hormone levels. That autoimmune stimulation is **Graves disease with thyroid eye disease**. Smoking roughly doubles orbitopathy risk and worsens its course, while radioiodine can flare eye disease unless steroid cover accompanies it in susceptible patients.
steps.say: Graves eyes obey antibodies, not hormone levels; eye disease may worsen while thyroid normalises.

steps.tx: Hashimoto and Graves may coexist or succeed each other in autoimmune thyroid spectrum, antibody panels and uptake scans separating hyperfunction causes when treatment diverges. That spectrum thinking is **autoimmune thyroid disease spectrum**. A diffusely high radioiodine uptake confirms new synthesis in Graves disease, whereas near absent uptake during thyrotoxicosis points to destructive release or factitious ingestion.
steps.say: One autoimmune gland can swing between Graves fire and Hashimoto ash across a lifetime.

steps.tx: Levothyroxine replaces Hashimoto hypothyroidism titrated by TSH, pregnancy raising requirements and newborn screening preventing congenital hypothyroidism cretinism catastrophes. That replacement duty is **levothyroxine in Hashimoto hypothyroidism**. Dose needs rise by roughly a fifth to a third in pregnancy, ideally adjusted as soon as pregnancy is confirmed, and TSH is rechecked about six weeks after any change.
steps.say: Titrate levothyroxine by TSH, raise it early in pregnancy, and never miss newborn screening.

vis.caption: Clinical photograph showing facial puffiness and coarse features of hypothyroidism.

steps.tx: Lymphoma risk rises slightly in longstanding Hashimoto glands, rapidly enlarging thyroid in Hashimoto patients earning biopsy against MALT lymphoma transformation. That vigilance is **thyroid lymphoma arising in Hashimoto disease**. Most are diffuse large B cell or MALT type B cell lymphomas, and hoarseness or stridor accompanying rapid growth should accelerate imaging and core biopsy.
steps.say: A Hashimoto gland suddenly enlarging earns biopsy; primary thyroid lymphoma grows in that soil.
